hypothesis: Acquired eight-unit outcomes separate long contexts that share the existing three-unit outcome association, increasing productive new Code programs.

candidate.evidence: actual general Code runtime/novelty feedback only; no added corpus prior

context_off: Same final context-trained memory, including all long-key counts, with only context_memory.enabled set to false; no retraining.
denominator: Every raw generated attempt; failures and source replays remain in the original seed slot.
productive_definition: Existing core field: runtime success and novelty relative to corpus; experience_replay can remain productive. Accepted/status counts and unique productive behavior hashes are reported separately.
freeplay: Separate frozen task=None evaluation of each final arm and task-trained replica; no extra training.

development_gate.margin_units: absolute number of productive attempts under equal fixed raw budget
development_gate.source_replay_per_task_pooled: at most first separately for table and numbers

confirmation: Only if development gate passes; fixed fresh seeds and same gate, all three table replicas must improve; no sweep.
gallery_selection: Development table replica 0, first evaluation seed where context is productive and first is not; if absent first productive context seed; if absent no success sample.
mechanism_audit: Frozen final memory: retrieval-off and deterministic long-key-count permutation, paired prefixes/probabilities and generated-source comparisons; no source editing.
